hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; g=$(command -v grasp || echo "$HOME/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/graspcode/plugins/graspcode/bin/grasp"); case "$f" in */lambda/scripts/archdocs/*.md) if [ -x "$g" ]; then "$g" archdoc lint "$f" --quiet || exit 2; fi; TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=1 npx ts-node "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/lint-docs.ts" "$f" --quiet || exit 2 ;; */lambda/scripts/plans/*.md) TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=1 npx ts-node "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/lint-docs.ts" "$f" --quiet || exit 2 ;; esac; }
